card.title: Hair Color & Roots
card.summary: All-over color, root touch-ups, highlights and color changes: lasting color built on a tone analysis.

lede: From covering grays to a completely new shade: at Emrahair, hair color is done with a formula built on a tone analysis and designed with your hair’s health in mind.
mediaAlt: Hairdresser applying color with foils to a client’s hair

sections.heading: Which hair color service is right for you?
body: All-over color changes or refreshes your color in a single shade from root to tip. A root touch-up matches grown-out roots or grays to your current color. Highlights and lowlights use fine strands to add depth and light, while a color change is a planned move from dark to light or from light to dark.
Which one suits you depends on your current color, how much gray you have and the shade you are aiming for. Every color service at Emrahair starts with a consultation.

sections.heading: Root color options: Italian, ammonia-free, Igora
body: Italian root color blends the color at the roots softly into the lengths, so there is no hard line. Ammonia-free root color is the choice for sensitive scalps and anyone sensitive to smell. Igora root color is used to cover grays with high coverage.
Root lightening means lifting dark regrowth in light blonde hair and toning it again; it is the service blondes need most often to maintain their color.

sections.heading: Keeping your color vibrant for longer
body: Not washing your hair for the first two days after coloring, using a sulfate-free, color-protecting shampoo and applying heat protectant before hot tools all help your color last longer. After the service, you’ll get care recommendations suited to your hair.

steps.heading: What to expect at your color appointment

items.title: Tone analysis
items.body: Your current color, amount of gray and target shade are assessed, and the right color and timing are chosen.

items.title: Application
items.body: Color is applied to the roots or all over, and the processing time is adjusted to your hair type.

items.title: Care and blow-dry
items.body: The color is sealed, a treatment is applied and your hair is blow-dried into shape.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions about hair color

items.q: How much does hair color cost in Bahçeşehir?
items.a: At Emrahair, all-over color is [[26-1]], Italian root color [[575809-1]], ammonia-free root color [[372904-1]], and highlights and lowlights [[29-1]]. The price of a color change is set at the consultation.

items.q: How often should I get my roots done?
items.a: Usually every 4–6 weeks, depending on how fast your hair grows and how much gray you have. With fewer grays, you can often go longer.

items.q: Does ammonia-free hair color cover gray?
items.a: It covers light to moderate gray well. If you have a lot of gray, a high-coverage color such as Igora may be recommended; that is decided at the consultation.

items.q: Can I go from dark hair to light in one session?
items.a: It depends on your hair’s history. For dark hair that has been colored before, the change may be split over several sessions to protect the hair’s health.

items.q: How long does hair coloring take?
items.a: A root touch-up usually takes 1.5–2 hours; all-over color and color changes take 2–4 hours, depending on hair length.
